rules.name: Pull drops and experience to the holder

meta.notes: A rule book for msm_examples:pull_charm. Every half second while a player holds the charm in the off hand, and is not sneaking, two Run a command steps run as that player: tp moves every dropped item and experience orb within 8 blocks to them, so they are picked up at once. Sneak to stop it. On export the book becomes a held event on the charm and a generated script, so it needs the Fabric mod jar export.
